claims.value: Photograph (colour); close up view of Ahu Ko Te Riku with a moai (figure carving) with its red pukao (hat) representing a tuft of hair, right side profile; Ahu Ko Te Riku, Easter Island.

notes.text: This British Museum catalogue record describes a 1980 photograph by Katesa Schlosser. It is registered as a documentary source, not as a physical Rapa Nui artefact, and no image is published. The complete Description field identifies the represented site as Ahu Ko Te Riku; the curator's contextual comment is collapsed in the live record and was not extracted.
